responsibility: This header declares the main buffered file I/O API of the mc-boot runtime. It publishes the FIO_File handle type, the standard stream objects, and the full set of operations for file existence tests, open/close, buffered and direct byte transfers, character/string/line access, end-of-file tests, random positioning, Unix descriptor access, and filename queries that define the runtime's central file subsystem.
same_name_distinction: Declares the public GFIO file API and exported FIO_File/standard-stream symbols, but does not contain the concrete descriptor-table, buffer-management, or libc-backed file operation implementation that lives in GFIO.cc.
